title: DEC-229: Taxonomy assignment-integrity reason precedence and the TermAssignment taxonomy key (2026-10-27)
text:
- **Problem**: The DEC-141 lane found BE03c silent on (1) the precedence and blockingCount of `cms.taxonomy.assignment_integrity` when several assignments fail and (2) which taxonomy version a TermAssignment row foreign key names.
- **Options considered**: (1) the pattern-provider rule vs a severity order or a per-reason count; (2) the term storage identity vs the vocabulary current active version.
- **Decision**: root implementation decision, owner may override: (1) first present reason in the BE03c listed order term_merged_unconverged, allowlist_changed, taxonomy_version_not_active; blockingCount = offending assignments + offending manifest versions (as the pattern provider). (2) The foreign key is the assigned term own (taxonomy_version_id, owner_id) storage identity, never the governing version; the governing versions are the revision recorded taxonomy_version_ids. Both match the lane implementation.
- **Downstream**: BE03c provider paragraph and DEC-141 item 3 sentences + changelog; AC-239 precedence/count clause provable by the lane tests.
- **Reversibility**: High.

title: DEC-230: An unsupported locale on the CMS-03C-04 write is 422, not 404 (owner, 2026-10-27)
text:
- **Problem**: BE03c contradicted itself on CMS-03C-04: the Route Registry (line 165) and AC-055 said a hidden or absent locale is 404, while the field matrix (locale must be a member of supportedLocales, 422) and the error matrix (404 = hidden/absent entry or source only) said 422; the code answers 422.
- **Options considered**: (A) 422 LOCALE_VALIDATION_FAILED on the write (code, field and error matrices; the editor can already read the supported locales, so nothing is concealed); (B) 404 like the read route cmsLocaleVariantRead (one behaviour for read and write; code change).
- **Decision**: A — owner Rob, 2026-10-27, "go with 422". The read keeps its policy-safe 404 for an unsupported locale.
- **Downstream**: BE03c Route Registry CMS-03C-04 row + changelog; AC-055 text in phase-2.md, the Slice 12 tracker and the ledger (new clause cited by the locale_config_enforcement pgTAP and a real-token Worker test). No code change.
- **Reversibility**: High.

title: DEC-231: 03c consumes no cms.publication.changed.v1; related eligibility is evaluated at read (2026-10-27)
text:
- **Problem**: AC-061 and the BE03c event table said 03c consumes cms.publication.changed.v1 to invalidate related/locale/composition eligibility; no consumer exists and the refutation dropped the read-time recompute citations for the clause.
- **Options considered**: (A) amend the spec — nothing in 03c stores eligibility a publication could invalidate; (B) build a consumer with nothing to invalidate.
- **Decision**: A (root decision, owner may override). Related eligibility is evaluated at read by CMS-03C-21, locale staleness is recorded in the source-change transaction, composition validity follows the governed recheck consumers. No code change.
- **Downstream**: BE03c event table row + changelog; AC-061 clause 9 in both trackers and the ledger, cited by the related_public_targets read-time recompute assertions.
- **Reversibility**: High.

title: DEC-232: DEC-196 nested-picker read cascaded as cmsPatternNestableRead (2026-10-27)
text:
- **Problem**: The owner chose a designer-only read of nestable patterns on 2026-10-15 (DEC-196), but no BE03c row, contract, SQL, Worker route or proxy existed, so the web lane could not build CmsPatternNestedPicker (AC-105).
- **Options considered**: route shape — (A) GET /api/v1/cms/patterns/nestable with a repeated contentTypeId query (1-64 UUIDs), PatternSelectorPage, paged like CMS-03C-13; (B) a POST read with a JSON body of type ids.
- **Decision**: A (root implementation decision implementing owner DEC-196; owner may override): `cmsPatternNestableRead`, cms.template_designer of the owner party, active versions whose compatibleTypeIds contains every requested type id (the DEC-181 nested rule), signed keyset cursor (patternKey ASC, patternVersion DESC) bound to route, type set, sort and acting context, limit 1-50 default 25, 300/600 per minute, 8,000 ms, no-store, Tier 1, composition catalog; RPC `cms_list_pattern_nestable`. It does not exclude the lineage being edited (cycles stay the save 409). AC-105 now names the picker over this read; AC-275 names the supporting reads without a count.
- **Downstream**: BE03c (all read sites + changelog), FE03 designer row + changelog, AC-105 and AC-275 texts (trackers + ledger, dec232 script), registry-parity fixture, contracts, OpenAPI, SQL, Worker, web proxy and the picker (implementation lane).
- **Reversibility**: High until the read ships.

title: DEC-233: Deprecated existing taxonomy assignments survive a re-sent value; duplicate termIds are refused (2026-10-27)
text:
- **Problem**: Review V12-06: cms_create_revision refused a re-sent taxonomy value holding an already-assigned deprecated term while cms_resolve_conflict accepted it; V12-07: duplicate termIds were stored as authored while assignments were de-duplicated, so value and assignment set disagreed.
- **Options considered**: V12-06 (A) a deprecated term the source revision already assigns in the same field is existing and accepted by both writers, (B) strict refusal by both; V12-07 (A) refuse duplicates 422 VALIDATION_FAILED at the field pointer, (B) canonicalise before hashing.
- **Decision**: V12-06 A (BE03c 1574 tolerates existing assignments and 1582 carries deprecated terms on restore, so an unrelated edit never forces removing a tag); V12-07 A (canonical value, matches the BE03b relation-target rule). Root decision, owner may override.
- **Downstream**: BE03c DEC-141 item 5 sentence + changelog; taxonomy-integrity WIP encoder and both writers; tests.
- **Reversibility**: High.
